select sr.id, srd.id as detailId, sr.code, sr.third_code as thirdCode, sr.customer_id as customerId, ci.name as customerName, sr.approve_status as approveStatus, sr.receipt_amount as totalReceiptAmount, sr.currency, srd.so_code as soCode, si.receive_amount - COALESCE(( select sum(red2.receipt_amount) from so_receipt re2 inner join so_receipt_detail red2 on re2.id = red2.main_id where re2.is_deleted = false and red2.is_deleted = false and re2.approve_status = 'approved' and red2.so_id = si.id ),0) as remainReceiptAmount, srd.receipt_amount as receiptAmount, srd.receipt_account as receiptAccount, srd.receipt_date as receiptDate, srd.dict_receipt_method as dictReceiptMethod, sr.is_posted as isPosted, sr.posted_account as postedAccount, sr.source_type as sourceType, sr.approve_time as approveTime, sr.approve_user_name as approveUserName, sr.create_time as createTime, sr.update_time as updateTime, sr.create_user_name as createUserName, sr.update_user_name as updateUserName, srd.remark from so_receipt sr inner join so_receipt_detail srd on sr.id = srd.main_id and srd.is_deleted = false inner join customer_info ci on ci.id = sr.customer_id and ci.is_deleted = false left join so_info si on srd.so_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sr.is_deleted = false
